The Merry Heart

William Shakespeare (1564–1616)

From “The Winter’s Tale,” Act 
IV.
 
Scene 2
J
OG
 on, jog on, the footpath way,
And merrily hent the stile-a:
A merry heart goes all the day,
Your sad tires in a mile-a.
